notes.nav.tab.description: Navigation tab label for the Notes module (notes & checklists).

notes.home.create_note.description: Create button/FAB action: start a new plain-text note.

notes.home.create_checklist.description: Create button/FAB action: start a new checklist note (items with checkboxes).

notes.home.search_placeholder.description: Placeholder inside the notes search field; matches note titles, content and checklist items.

notes.drawer.notes.description: Drawer entry: the main list of active notes and checklists.

notes.drawer.trash.description: Drawer entry: trashed notes (status=trashed), purged after 30 days.

notes.drawer.tags_header.description: Drawer section header above the per-business tag list used to filter notes.

notes.action.edit.description: Note popup/long-press action: open the note or checklist for editing.

notes.action.share.description: Note popup action: share the note's text via the system share sheet.

notes.action.delete.description: Note popup action: move the note to Trash (from Trash it means delete forever; needs the notes.delete permission there).

notes.action.complete.description: Note popup action: move the note to the Completed list (status=completed).

notes.action.restore.description: Note popup action in Completed/Trash: move the note back to the active Notes list.

notes.action.pin.description: Note popup action: pin the note to the top of the list.

notes.action.unpin.description: Note popup action: remove the pin so the note sorts normally again.

notes.action.uncomplete.description: Note popup action on a completed note: move it back to the active Notes list (status completed -> active).

notes.action.delete_forever.description: Trash-only note popup action: permanently remove the note (tombstone purge). Requires the notes.delete permission.

notes.action.share_copied.description: Snackbar shown when Share falls back to copying the note text to the clipboard (system share sheet unavailable).

notes.editor.title_placeholder.description: Placeholder/label of the note title field in the note editor popup.

notes.editor.content_placeholder.description: Placeholder/label of the plain-text body field in the note editor popup (kind=note).

notes.editor.checklist_add.description: Placeholder/label of the add-checklist-item field in the checklist editor (kind=checklist).

notes.editor.checklist_remove.description: Accessible name of the per-item remove (x) button in the checklist editor.

notes.picker.color_title.description: Title of the note color picker (swatches from booking-colors.json).

notes.picker.color_default.description: First swatch in the note color picker: no color key stored, themed default surface.

notes.picker.tags_title.description: Title of the tag picker sheet where tags are assigned to a note.

notes.picker.tags_new.description: Action in the tag picker: create a new tag for this business.

notes.picker.tags_name_placeholder.description: Placeholder in the new-tag name input inside the tag picker.

notes.trash.notice.value: Items in trash are removed after 30 days
notes.trash.notice.description: Banner at the top of the Trash list explaining the 30-day auto-purge.

notes.home.empty_title.description: Empty-state title on the Notes list when the business has no active notes.

notes.home.empty_message.value: Create your first note or checklist.
notes.home.empty_message.description: Empty-state message under notes.home.empty_title, pointing at the create actions.

notes.completed.empty.description: Empty-state text on the Completed list when nothing has been marked complete.

notes.trash.empty.description: Empty-state text on the Trash list when no notes are trashed.

notes.search.empty.description: Empty-state text when a notes search returns no results.

notes.permission.group.description: Permission matrix group header for the notes module (rendered like auth.permissions.group_booking).

notes.permission.action_view.description: Permission toggle for notes.view: see notes, checklists, tags, Completed and Trash.

notes.permission.action_create.description: Permission toggle for notes.create: add notes/checklists (and tags while creating).

notes.permission.action_edit.description: Permission toggle for notes.edit: edit, pin, complete/restore, trash/restore, manage tags.

notes.permission.action_delete.description: Permission toggle for notes.delete: purge notes from Trash permanently.

notes.editor.title_hint.description: Placeholder of the note title field in the note editor dialog.

notes.editor.content_hint.description: Placeholder of the plain-text body field in the note editor dialog.

notes.editor.add_item.description: Button in the checklist editor: append a new empty checklist item.

notes.editor.remove_item.description: Icon action on a checklist editor row: delete that item.

notes.editor.move_up.description: Icon action on a checklist editor row: move the item one position up (simple reorder).

notes.drawer.open.description: Content description / long-press explanation of the notes screen's hamburger button that opens the drawer.

notes.trash.delete_forever_title.description: Title of the confirmation dialog before permanently deleting a note from Trash.

notes.trash.delete_forever_message.value: This note will be deleted permanently.
notes.trash.delete_forever_message.description: Body of the delete-forever confirmation dialog in Trash.
